questions.correct_answer: (a_n) is Cauchy, because |a_m - a_n| ≤ 2/2^n for all m > n, so it converges in R
questions.explanation: By the triangle inequality and a geometric sum, for m > n we get |a_m - a_n| ≤ sum_{k=n}^{m-1} 1/2^k < 2/2^n, which tends to 0, so the sequence is Cauchy. Since R is complete, every Cauchy sequence of reals converges.
